title: Sparkly corn cob
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Corn cob body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="18" ry="30" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  
  <!-- Kernel rows - left column -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="30" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="42" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="54" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="66" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  
  <!-- Kernel rows - right column -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="30" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="42" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="54" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="66" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  
  <!-- Kernel rows - center -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="24" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFC107"/>
  
  <!-- Highlight kernels -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="30" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="42" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="54" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="66" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  
  <!-- Husk leaves -->
  <path d="M32 30 Q18 15 22 35 Q25 42 35 38 Z" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <path d="M68 30 Q82 15 78 35 Q75 42 65 38 Z" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <path d="M30 42 Q12 40 20 55 Q25 60 34 52 Z" fill="#81C784"/>
  <path d="M70 42 Q88 40 80 55 Q75 60 66 52 Z" fill="#81C784"/>
  
  <!-- Husk tip at bottom -->
  <path d="M42 80 Q50 92 58 80 Q52 78 50 82 Q48 78 42 80 Z" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <g transform="translate(20,12)">
    <polygon points="0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <g transform="translate(82,10)">
    <polygon points="0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 3 - left -->
  <g transform="translate(10,50)">
    <polygon points="0,-7 1.8,-1.8 7,0 1.8,1.8 0,7 -1.8,1.8 -7,0 -1.8,-1.8" fill="#FFECB3"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 4 - right -->
  <g transform="translate(90,48)">
    <polygon points="0,-5.5 1.4,-1.4 5.5,0 1.4,1.4 0,5.5 -1.4,1.4 -5.5,0 -1.4,-1.4" fill="#FFECB3"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 5 - bottom -->
  <g transform="translate(78,82)">
    <polygon points="0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="65" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="75" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
</svg>
